Native App info launch and return to the same detail sheet

googleDocumentationReviewed.finding: Reviewed Android 17 behavior changes, including memory limits and explicit URI grant guidance.
Reviewed target-37 behavior, including activity-launch hardening. Settings launches were tested from the foreground.
MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE requires user approval in Settings and still does not grant another app's private directories.
Data includes cache, so cache must be subtracted for a separate Data field. App bytes include OBB files.
The system dialog clears app external cache directories only after user confirmation; it is not direct access to private caches.
Files by Google provides explicit cleanup suggestions with confirmation before permanent deletion.

limitations: Not tested on physical devices, older Android versions, SD cards or USB volumes.
No root access or bypass of Android's private-storage restrictions.
This run did not repeat every external-app, uninstall, share and cache-clearing manual check.
No version tag or public release was published; GitHub's tag-triggered release job was not run.
Measurements are observations from this emulator, not fixed expected values for other devices.
